recusal.title: Declare a connection and recuse yourself
recusal.description: You declare a connection with one of the organizations behind this submission and withdraw from its evaluation. The declaration is kept: it is what attests to the committee's impartiality.
recusal.reasonHint: Required. One sentence is enough: membership, ongoing collaboration, personal interest.
recusal.reasonRequired: State the nature of the connection before recusing yourself.
recusal.success: You have recused yourself from this submission. The committee is informed.
recusal.done: You recused yourself from this submission on {date}.

peers.empty: No other review has been submitted yet.

blind.title: Blind review
blind.description: This call runs blind: you will see your peers' scores as soon as you submit yours. This prevents the first score from setting the tone for the others.
blind.count: No review submitted yet | One review has already been submitted | {count} reviews have already been submitted

comments.title: Discussion
comments.description: Two threads on one submission: what the committee writes to itself, and what is addressed to the organization.

committee.label: Internal to the committee
committee.hint: Read by committee members and the IFDD team. The organization does not see it.

submitter.hint: Sent to the lead organization, which is notified. A message that has been read cannot be taken back.
